name: Verrik
body:
The verrik are a crimson-skinned humanoid race characterized by sensory tendrils, acute intellectual discipline, and latent mental powers. Highly organized and contemplative, they value law, precision, and inner balance.

Standard Racial Traits
Ability Score Modifiers: Verrik possess razor-sharp intellects and extraordinary willpower, but their slender frames are fragile. They gain +2 Intelligence, +2 Wisdom, and -2 Constitution.
Type: Humanoid (verrik). Verrik are humanoids with the verrik subtype.
Size: Medium. Verrik have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
Speed: Normal. Verrik have a base land speed of 30 feet.
Languages: Verrik begin play speaking Common and Verrik. Bonus languages include Celestial, Draconic, Elven, Giant, and Undercommon.
Senses and Defense Racial Traits
Sensory Attunement (Ex): Fine neural tendrils provide verrik with extraordinary perception. They cannot be flanked and gain a +2 racial bonus on Perception and Sense Motive checks.
Mental Bastion: Verrik gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects and psychic spells.
Magical and Psionic Racial Traits
Psychic Spark (Sp): A verrik can cast mage hand and message at will as spell-like abilities. In campaigns utilizing psionics, a verrik gains 1 bonus power point.
Focused Mind: Verrik receive a +2 racial bonus on concentration checks made to cast spells defensively.
